resources.string: Activate on this phone using Wireless debugging. Open Phone activation for pairing and reconnection.
Could not start. Check permissions and try again from this page.
Could not confirm that the assistant was disabled. Refresh and check again.
This settings page is unavailable on this device.
ADB control disconnected. Task paused; activate again and observe the screen before continuing.
ADB connected. Touch takeover detection is unavailable; main-screen automation is disabled.

Connect to Wi-Fi. Open Wireless debugging and enable it yourself. Use split screen with AIOS and Settings, then select Pair device with pairing code. Keep that dialog open and enter its pairing port and six-digit code below. No computer or second app is needed.

Leave blank to discover this phone. If discovery fails, enter the port on the main Wireless debugging page, not the pairing port. After reboot, open this page and activate again; enable Wireless debugging if needed.
Pairing… Keep the system pairing dialog open.
Connecting and starting the control service…
Enter a valid port (1–65535) and a six-digit pairing code.
Pairing failed. Keep the pairing dialog open and check its current code and port.
Activation failed. Check Wireless debugging and its connection port. If this app was forgotten in Settings, pair again.
Choose AIOS in system assistant settings. Power-button shortcuts depend on your phone. Use the Assistant tile for direct access.
Set up your model and device access. You can skip this guide and configure everything later in Settings.
Manage model accounts, device activation and permissions.
Device control needs activation; chatting remains available. Tap to activate or reconnect.
Choose the model account used by the assistant.
Manage the assistant and background task authorization.
Allow the assistant to inspect and interact with app screens.
Show the assistant panel over your current app.
Allow notification events to be used by the assistant.
Show task progress and requests for your attention.
Tap a preview to view the screen. Swipe right for conversations and tasks.
Swipe right for mini apps; swipe left for the workspace
This mini app is unavailable. Open the mini app list to check its current installation.

After pairing, AIOS restores the control service while authorization and wireless debugging are enabled. Interrupted actions stay paused. Keep AIOS running; after a force stop, reopen it. If pairing is removed, pair again.
